questions.prompt: The general led the legions of many nations across the swift river.
questions.answer: Dux legiōnēs multārum gentium trāns flūmen vēlōx dūxit.

questions.prompt: The citizens defended the walls of the cities with great courage.
questions.answer: Cīvēs mūrōs urbium magnā virtūte dēfendērunt.

questions.prompt: Many ships of the enemy were burned in the deep sea.
questions.answer: Multae nāvēs hostium in marī profundō incēnsae sunt.

questions.prompt: At night the animals fled from the fires of the burning forest.
questions.answer: Nocte animālia ex ignibus silvae ferventis fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: The strength of the mountains protected the small village from the winds.
questions.answer: Vīs montium vīcum modicum ā ventīs dēfendēbat.

questions.prompt: The bravest of the citizens climbed the towers of the citadel.
questions.answer: Fortissimus cīvium turrēs arcis ascendit.

questions.prompt: With his spur he urged the horse across the bridge over the river.
questions.answer: Calcārī equum trāns pontem super flūmen incitāvit.

questions.prompt: Having seized the spoils, the soldiers returned to the territory of the enemy.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs, spoliīs dīreptīs, ad fīnēs hostium revertērunt.

questions.prompt: The vastness of the seas terrified the sailors of every city.
questions.answer: Magnitūdō marium nautās omnium urbium terrēbat.

questions.prompt: In a single night the birds crossed the borders of many lands.
questions.answer: Ūnā nocte avēs multārum terrārum fīnēs trānsiērunt.

questions.prompt: The teeth of the wild animals were sharper than swords.
questions.answer: Dentēs ferārum animālium gladiīs acūtiōrēs erant.

questions.prompt: The more honorable citizen gave part of his wealth to the poor of the city.
questions.answer: Cīvis honestior partem frūctūs suī pauperibus urbis dedit.

questions.prompt: The barren fields produced no fruits for the animals of the herd.
questions.answer: Agrī sterilēs nūllōs frūctūs animālibus gregis tulērunt.

questions.prompt: The swiftness of the ships surpassed the winds of the sea.
questions.answer: Vēlōcitās nāvium ventōs maris superābat.

questions.prompt: By the fires of the city the cook boiled down the tender thyme.
questions.answer: Ignibus urbis coquus thymum tenerum dēcoxit.

questions.prompt: The expenses of the war exhausted the resources of all the cities.
questions.answer: Sumptūs bellī omnium urbium opēs cōnsūmpsērunt.

questions.answer: In continentī legiōnēs pontēs super flūmina aedificāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The bravest of the young men fell in the battle of the two peoples.
questions.answer: Fortissimus iuvenum in proeliō duārum gentium cecidit.

questions.prompt: The venerable arts of the ancient citizens delighted the minds of the youth.
questions.answer: Venerābilēs artēs antīquōrum cīvium animōs iuventūtis dēlectābant.

questions.answer: Cīvēs prūdentēs multārum urbium īram deōrum timēbant.

questions.prompt: The ships of the enemies were sunk in the deep sea during the night.
questions.answer: Nāvēs hostium in altō marī nocte mersae sunt.

questions.answer: Vī animī senex mōrēs gentium ferārum sprēvit.

questions.answer: Imperātor calcāria in lateribus equōrum celerium posuit.

questions.prompt: The clouds hid the peaks of the high mountains from the sailors.
questions.answer: Nūbēs cacūmina altōrum montium nautīs cēlāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The bravery of the citizens saved the walls of the besieged city.
questions.answer: Virtūs cīvium moenia urbis obsessae servāvit.

questions.prompt: The famous poet, master of many arts, praised the deeds of the ancients.
questions.answer: Clārus poēta, multārum artium magister, facta veterum laudāvit.

questions.prompt: The strength of the bridges held back the force of the rushing rivers.
questions.answer: Firmitās pontium vim amnium ruentium sustinuit.

questions.answer: Multīs noctibus custōdēs portās arcis servābant.

questions.prompt: The teeth of the wild beasts frightened the young shepherd.
questions.answer: Dentēs ferārum bēstiārum pāstōrem iuvenem terruērunt.

questions.prompt: The birds of the sky fled from the fires of the burning city.
questions.answer: Avēs caelī ab ignibus urbis ārdentis fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: The wild animal lay hidden in the deep sea.
questions.answer: Animal ferum in altō marī latēbat.

questions.prompt: The rider urged his horse on with sharp spurs.
questions.answer: Eques equum acūtīs calcāribus incitāvit.

questions.prompt: The force of the sea broke the ships of the merchants.
questions.answer: Vīs maris nāvēs mercātōrum frēgit.

questions.prompt: Many seas separate the lands of distant nations.
questions.answer: Multa maria terrās gentium remōtārum dīvidunt.

questions.prompt: The force of the winter rains destroyed the crops of the poor.
questions.answer: Vīs imbrium hībernōrum segetēs pauperum dēlēvit.

questions.prompt: The doctor healed the diseases of many parts of the body.
questions.answer: Medicus morbōs multārum partium corporis sānāvit.

questions.answer: Turrēs urbis suprā nūbēs stābant.

questions.answer: Ēnsibus cīvium tyrannus interfectus est.

questions.answer: Marī et terrā cīvēs pācis dōna petēbant.

questions.answer: Cīvis quī mare trānsierat mōrēs gentium externārum nārrāvit.

questions.answer: Paucōrum mīlitum virtūs moenia oppidī servāvit.

questions.answer: Nāvēs multārum urbium ad ōstia lātī flūminis convēnērunt.

questions.prompt: The seas of the north used to terrify the sailors with their great waves.
questions.answer: Maria septentriōnis nautās magnīs flūctibus terrēbant.

questions.answer: Rēx omnēs cīvēs urbis pontem aedificāre iussit.

questions.answer: In nāvibus partēs exercitūs ad lītora hostium nāvigābant.

questions.answer: Nūbēs noctis omnium montium cacūmina operuērunt.
